sub_issue.title: [finance 01/09] Add the finance module manifest and labels
[finance 02/09] Seed the transactions and categories databases for new and existing tenants
[finance 03/09] Link transactions to companies, projects and documents
[finance 06/09] Let the agent read the finance summary
[finance 07/09] Declare the expense link rules to its document
[finance 08/09] Add the expense step to file proposals
[finance 09/09] Gate agent writes to finance databases

body: Finance is not being implemented now (product decision, 2026-10-25), so this is closed as not planned. The rest of the backend plan stays generic so Finance can be added later as an ordinary system module (module + seed + per-tenant cutover, link rules in the manifest, multi-step Inbox proposals, Inbox type target allow-list, per-database Semp grants, closed risk class set). Reopen when Finance is planned again.
